author: claude-code
head: b6ce4ffabe0e66a102e224e75be575a501c5a793
body: Orchestrator review of the PR of dotfiles-T128-chain-review-scripts-a01 (plan 021 step 6.3, the review-side chain scripts: scripts/orchestrator/local-review.sh runs the review binary read-only in the review worktree at a PR head, the binary resolved in the repository root before the checkout (CODEX_BIN or codex), the worktree refused unless it is a worktree root and clean, one validation file written, one review per head; local-advisory.sh appends advisory rows and local-finding lines under the owner heading and stops on P0/P1; sandbox-scan.sh prints a worker sandbox record's unsandboxed mutation calls; tests/unit/test_chain_review_scripts.py with its three tests on a stub review binary, a decoy in the head commit and a temporary repository) at its final head: every item of the task's Files section (amendment 1: row 11's tools, the worktree-root refusal with its case, the mktemp template) is implemented and nothing else; the attached inputs' behaviour is kept except the changes the items name; the Bot's single review (on PR open) and the local review and the audit of the final head are each fixed in the head or advisory, owned by dotfiles-T128-chain-review-scripts-followup-a01 (written at the first advisory P2); the caps (200 changed lines outside tests/ and .orchestration/, 1000 under tests/) hold. Approved for the gate at the audited head.
